Create a professional Finrival comparison report for GOOGL vs MSFT using the 5Y data window.

Finrival AI is thinking...

• Over the supplied 5-year historical window, GOOGL demonstrated higher long-term growth with a 19.02% CAGR compared to MSFT's 11.49%, though MSFT led recent common-date pair performance by 21.30 percentage points and traded at its series high.

• The primary trade-off is risk versus return: GOOGL offers strong historical growth but experienced higher historical price fluctuations (29.66% volatility vs MSFT's 27.82%) and a deeper maximum loss from peak to trough (44.32% drawdown vs MSFT's 37.56%).

• MSFT displays stronger recent buying momentum with a 14-period Relative Strength Index (RSI) of 62.98, compared to GOOGL's 56.38; however, elevated momentum indicates recent price strength, not a guaranteed continuation or immediate price reversal.

• Their moderate historical return correlation of 0.44 shows these stocks occasionally move independently, but historical co-movement does not ensure future diversification or risk protection.
